content: Nixtla statsforecast benchmark methodology: uses M1, M3, M4, Tourism datasets; primary metrics MASE and sMAPE (and OWA for M4); evaluates per frequency group (Yearly, Quarterly, Monthly, etc.); includes Naive2 as mandatory baseline; reports computation time as secondary metric; M4Evaluation class available in datasetsforecast package. Cross-validation methodology: rolling-origin (time-series CV) is standard practice — no random folds. augurs (Grafana Rust library) has benchmarks but does not yet compare formally against reference implementations. sktime replicated M4 study to validate its API; uses median sMAPE in addition to mean to mitigate outlier influence. R forecast/fable: computes accuracy() with MAE, RMSE, MAPE, MASE, sMAPE by default; uses seasonal naive as baseline; fabletools provides CRPS for distributional models via distribution_accuracy_measures().
